name: Litany Of Sure Steel
body:
School divination; Level antipaladin 1, inquisitor 1, paladin 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one willing creature
Duration 1 round
Saving Throw no; Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

This litany allows a target to sheath and switch weapons and items without being distracted from the perils of combat. The target may manipulate objects on their person without provoking attacks of opportunity, such as sheathing or reloading weapons, retrieving stored items, drinking potions, or lighting torches.

While under the effects of this spell, the target cannot be the target of another spell that has the word litany in the title.
